summary: The linuxcnc Post-Processor writes a tilted Work Plane as G68.2 / G53.1 / G69 with a new twp_kinematics_select Machine property and refuses DWO, and all machine-based Post-Processors now track the arc plane (G17/G18/G19) and drop only the arc center word along the normal of the plane.

pages.reason: Path/Post/scripts/linuxcnc_post.py: ROTATION_STRATEGIES = ("twp",) and PLANE_COMMAND = G68_2 add tilted Work Plane output to linuxcnc; Path/Post/Processor.py _convert_move: a G17 arc no longer carries K in the output of each machine-based Post-Processor

linuxcnc_post.py get_property_schema: new twp_kinematics_select property, new help for pre_rotary_move and twp_align, PARAMETER_ORDER override removed; Processor.py _command_names: ignored and supported command lists match name by name, G17/G18/G19 are supported modal commands

Path/Base/MachineState.py: new Plane attribute and addGcodeText(); Processor.py: _command_names name-by-name filter, empty command name allowed, _convert_move drops the center word along the plane normal; linuxcnc_post.py is now a reference for ROTATION_STRATEGIES and PLANE_COMMAND

Path/Post/scripts/fanuc_post.py: parameter_order default override removed (K is in the default again) and G17 removed from EXTRA_SUPPORTED; Processor.py _convert_move: a G18 arc keeps K and drops J, a G19 arc drops I
Path/Base/MachineState.py: Plane attribute (default G17, not in Tracked, kept by setState(None) and copy()) and addGcodeText(); Constants.py: GCODE_PLANE added to GCODE_SUPPORTED
sections: List of currently supported G-code commands

pages.reason: linuxcnc_post.py get_property_schema: twp_kinematics_select has SCOPE_MACHINE, thus it shows in the Post-Processor properties of the Machine; ROTATION_STRATEGIES = ("twp",) makes a Machine set to DWO raise an error with linuxcnc
linuxcnc_post.py: linuxcnc now declares a tilted Work Plane (G68.2, G53.1 or G53.6, G69), cancels the plane before each fixture and tool change, and supports only the twp rotation strategy
CAMTests/TestHeidenhainPost.py only: G18 and G19 stay refused as before; no hunk changes the heidenhain Post-Processor source or its output
